text:
Anya: Quick alignment — perf dashboard shows a 12% p95 latency regression on the inference hotpath after the recent kernel merge (PR #4821). Can owners + SRE confirm scope?
Sam: saw that, digging in. PR 4821 touched continuous batching heuristics and a small change to KV lock ordering.
Lee: I was on duty when it spiked. Traces point to an extra 6–9ms on kv.get for long context requests.
Morgan: cc @eng-sre — any ongoing deploys around that window? I didn't see a canary.
devops-bot: Alert: latency-regression service=inference-runtime env=prod p95_inference increased from 42ms -> 47ms at 2026-03-16T14:02:10Z. <https://perf.redwood/internal/alerts/latency-1777>
Natalie: Can we confirm whether the kernel change shipped to prod or only to staging? I remember we gated canary to 10% but not sure it finished.
Sam: It was merged and a canary was started; rollout command was:
```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-runtime -n prod
kubectl annotate deployment/inference-runtime redwood/canary=10%
```
but the annotation job hit a race and left the config at 100% for a short time (logs show a retry loop at 14:01:58).
Jordan: I captured a flame graph — the extra time is in kv::lookup -> serialize_kv_response. Looks like a new lock contention path when batching coalesces keys across shards.
Anya: Ownership check — Sam and Lee were kernel owners for that change; Morgan + eng-sre for rollout automation; Natalie for release gating. Confirm?
Lee: yes, Sam authored, I reviewed. I'll own the immediate mitigation (revert or patch).
Sam: I can push a targeted patch to avoid the lock escalation (small change, low-risk). Will draft PR and request an urgent review.
Natalie: If patch will take >30m, prefer rollback to previous kernel SHA to restore latency while patch lands.
Morgan: SRE can pause the rollout and manually scale canary back to 0% if we want a fast rollback. I can run the commands once we decide.
devops-bot: Automations: canary_pause job queued by @Morgan at 1777777038 (pending manual approval). See: <https://ci.redwood/jobs/3867>
Sam: I'm opening PR #4872 with the lock reorder patch now. Title: "avoid lock escalation in kv batching path (hotfix)" — requesting Lee for quick review.
Lee: will review in ~10m, tagging @Jordan for perf signoff after review.
Jordan: will run perf harness on the patch once CI artifacts are available. ETA 15m.
Anya: Ok plan: 1) Morgan/SRE pause the canary (if immediate) OR 2) if patch lands <30m, patch -> canary -> perf check -> proceed. Sam/Lee own patch. Jordan runs perf. Natalie owns gating decision. Morgan runs rollback if needed.
Sam: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/rt/PR-4872 — patch is minimal. Including test that simulates cross-shard batch.
Natalie: I'll monitor the dashboard and decide at T+30. If p95 still >+5% after 30m, we rollback.
Morgan: Pausing canary now (running manual approval). Running:
```
ci approve canary_pause 3867 --by Morgan
kubectl scale deployment/inference-runtime --replicas=3 -n prod
```
Anya: thanks everyone. Keep updates short here. If you need me to reassign ownership, ping me.
Sam: I'll post status in 10m with PR link + CI perf numbers.
Lee: reviewing now.
Jordan: queued perf run, will paste summary when done.
Natalie: thanks — holding on gating decision until Jordan's perf output.
Anya: (thumbsup)
